claims.text: Is to evaluate the most advanced models before and after deployment, with pre-launch access through voluntary agreements with developers.
Is to develop evaluation methodology and tools, and standards for safe testing environments.
Is to give technical support to AESIA, the supervisory authority, in market surveillance and in helping companies prepare.
Is to provide the General State Administration with a periodic report on how the capabilities and risks of frontier models evolve.
The government's IA360 plan assigns it technical advice to the General State Administration.
Is to cooperate internationally with counterpart institutes in other countries and with the European AI Office.
The IA360 plan sets as a milestone the setting up of the institute's initial technical core before the end of 2026.
Is to define response protocols for incidents arising from the behaviour of advanced models or agents, in coordination with INCIBE and the National Cryptologic Centre.
